answer:
What I did
- Reviewed our prior classification for this conversation and the Verta knowledge-base fragments we retrieved earlier.

What I found
- Reason code chosen: goods_not_received.
- Chargeback window for goods_not_received: 90 days from the transaction date (from disputes.md).
- Important warnings from the KB:
  - The reason code must match what actually happened; filing under the wrong code is declined and refile may miss the window (reason-codes.md).
  - A withdrawn dispute is final and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code (disputes-process.md).
  - The reason code determines the chargeback window and the evidence required (glossary.md).

What happens next
- I will not open a dispute unless you explicitly ask (per your instruction).
- If you want me to check whether a particular transaction is eligible to be disputed under goods_not_received, reply with the transaction ID, transaction date, and amount and I will run a dispute-eligibility check (this check does not open a dispute).
- If you prefer, I can also escalate this to a human agent or send an account statement for the period containing the transaction — tell me which you want.
